notes.title: Dev Log and Release date
notes.notes:
Hello there,

Did you think we had forgotten you? 

Well no. We decided to question ourselves regarding the creation of the game, we took each person's feedback and we brainstormed to find a solution and avenues for improvement while retaining our strengths. 

For example, the user interface has been and will continue to be redesigned, with more inventory space, and much more interesting visual effects on the screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/f1734eb2696c6e1d7aacec299b47f97ce6cdb8ca.png

For the environments, despite the positive feedback already obtained from the tests, we decided to make the universe even more alive with bases with advanced architecture and themes as you can see here in this building sneak peak ;)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/a5600bd4bd19ff2b308a3212d0586cfdc1207eb3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/faa89611cd6421c2db0f3c66fcf782fd82f47383.png

Plants and creatures are still being created with more interesting textures and gimmicks worth checking out.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/1cc3d21e4b5df29f62ea627812bb7d9afb187df3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/a8aea503122606a89bf783c8ac6e0baf4bcf7da8.png

We have decided to increase the number of passive mobs in the game in order to make it more lively!

And we have listened to your advice on tutorials and gamefeel elements.



So, when will the game be released?

Our main mistake was wanting to release a game with a good concept but poorly executed due to our impatience. Therefore, we are going to postpone the development of the game for a year. Not only to add new gameplay elements, refine what is already done, but also to be able to add achievements or lore in more depth.

This is why the game will be released in the 4th quarter of 2025 or in early 2026 depending on the game releases. 

We understand the issues, and will try to do our best for you and the game.

And happy new year 2025 to all those who follow us!
